code: <TopNav startContent={<TopNavMegaMenu label="Products" items={<TopNavMegaMenuItem title="Materials" description="Surface foundations" onClick={selectMaterials} />} featured={<TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard title="Build your workspace"><Button label="Explore starter" onClick={selectStarter} /></TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard>} />} />

name: Tour
description: Start, advance, dismiss, and restart a two-step tour anchored to real controls.
material: Public extension components inherit the surrounding Vesper tokens; semantic colors remain distinct.

name: TransferList
description: Choose collection details and compare Apply-first with immediate changes.
material: Public extension components inherit the surrounding Vesper tokens; semantic colors remain distinct.
code: <TransferListSelector label="Visible collection fields" width="min(41rem, 100cqi)" options={fieldOptions} value={fields} onChange={setFields} commitBehavior="staged" /><ComplexSelector label="Custom field picker" value={customFields} onChange={setCustomFields}>{(_value, commit) => <TransferList label="Custom visible fields" options={fieldOptions} value={customFields} onChange={commit} />}</ComplexSelector> // Immediate wrapper: container: vesper-transfer-list / inline-size

name: TreeList
description: Expandable library branches with native connector guides, current selection, and local leaf actions.
material: Expanded branches reveal the library hierarchy.
code: <TreeList header="Library" items={[{id: 'foundations', label: 'Foundations', isExpanded: true, children: [{id: 'surfaces', label: 'Surfaces', isSelected, onClick: selectSurfaces}]}]} />

name: Reviewer lookup
description: Search a delayed local directory, handle unavailable results and retry without losing the chosen reviewer.
material: Readable surfaces preserve selected and semantic states.

name: Vega chart
description: A local Vega-Lite bar specification compiled and rendered by the real Vega runtime.
material: Data marks remain sharp on a readable chart surface; no blur is applied to chart data.
code:
<VegaChart spec={{$schema: 'https://vega.github.io/schema/vega-lite/v6.json',
  data: {values: weekly}, mark: 'bar',
  encoding: {x: {field: 'day', type: 'ordinal'}, y: {field: 'value', type: 'quantitative'}}
}} viewOptions={{renderer: 'svg'}} onError={reportError} />

name: WebGL heatmap
description: Twelve actual GPU cells with an explicit 0–10 color domain and readable row data.
material: Data marks remain sharp on a readable chart surface; no blur is applied to chart data.
code:
<LabChart data={heatCells} xKey="day" yKeys={['value']}>
  <ChartHeatmapGL xKey="day" yKey="row" valueKey="value" colorRange={palette.sequential.blue(5)} domain={[0, 10]} />
</LabChart>

name: WebGL ring buffer
description: Replay a static sequence through the actual imperative GPU ring buffer; no simulated live feed.
material: Data marks remain sharp on a readable chart surface; no blur is applied to chart data.
code:
<ChartStreamGL handleRef={handle} color={color} bufferSize={32} />
// After mount:
handle.current.clear();
samples.forEach(d => handle.current.push(d.x, d.value));

name: WebGL scatter & picking
description: GPU scatter and GPU color-picking on the same nine fixed points.
material: Data marks remain sharp on a readable chart surface; no blur is applied to chart data.
code:
<LabChart data={samples} xKey="x" yKeys={['value']} xDomain={[-0.5, 8.5]}>
  {picking ? <ChartDotGLInteractive dataKey="value" color={color} size={14} />
    : <ChartDotGL dataKey="value" color={color} size={14} />}
</LabChart>

name: Reading shimmer
description: Text carries the progress while notes become a concise summary.
material: A moving highlight within text; readable without motion.

name: Document shimmer
description: A filled document icon signals a finite read with recovery.
material: The highlight belongs to the icon, not an extra panel.

name: Composing grid
description: A small sequential grid accompanies a local reply draft.
material: A compact 3 × 3 indicator leaves the content in focus.

name: Review before action
description: Inspect a draft revision, accept or keep the original, undo, then approve locally.
material: Native controls with a finite, text-carried approval state.

name: Parallel tool recovery
description: Gather two sources, inspect results, recover a failed step without rerunning completed work, or stop safely.
material: Native tool-call rows with partial completion and targeted retry.
code:
import {ParallelToolsStudy} from './ToolFeedbackStudies';
<ParallelToolsStudy />

name: Response feedback
description: Rate a response, explain what should improve, then edit or remove the local feedback.
material: A reversible feedback loop with a reason and optional note.
code:
import {ResponseFeedbackStudy} from './ToolFeedbackStudies';
<ResponseFeedbackStudy />
